Vivekananda’s New York lectures on the yoga of the mind (1896), with his translation of and commentary on the Yoga Sūtras, in the edition of 1920.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Râja yoga : being lectures by the Swâmi Vivekânanda · Vivekananda, Swami, 1863-1902, Patañjali, Vivekananda, Swami, 1863-1902, Vivekananda, Swami, 1863-1902, Vivekananda, Swami, 1863-1902, Patanjali · 1920, 300 scanned pages. First published 1896, this edition 1920; Swami Vivekananda died 1902; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
